e.title: revdbayes (R)
e.summary: 贝叶斯极值分析 R 包（UCL Northrop）：Ratio-of-Uniforms 抽样，2026 仍活跃
e.body:
revdbayes 是贝叶斯极值模型分析工具（UCL 的 Paul Northrop，v1.5.7，2026-03 仍更新）：用 Ratio-of-Uniforms 方法对极值模型（GEV/GPD 等）做贝叶斯推断，配套 rust 包支持。把 EVT 与贝叶斯结合——参数不确定性的完整后验表达，适用于巨灾风险、重尾损失的贝叶斯建模。与 [[evd]]/[[evir]]（频率派）互补，关联 [[mev]]、[[tailloss]]、[[extremes]]、[[actuarial-pricing]]。

## 同类工具
[[risk-profiler]]、[[riskportfolios]]、[[risky-router]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]

e.summary_en: Bayesian extreme-value analysis R package (UCL Northrop): Ratio-of-Uniforms sampling, still active in 2026
e.summary_hk: 貝葉斯極值分析 R 包（UCL Northrop）：Ratio-of-Uniforms 抽樣，2026 仍活躍
e.body_en:
revdbayes provides Bayesian analysis of extreme value models (Paul Northrop, UCL; v1.5.7, updated 2026-03): it uses Ratio-of-Uniforms sampling for Bayesian inference of EV models (GEV/GPD etc.), with the companion rust package. It combines EVT with Bayesian methods — full posterior representation of parameter uncertainty — suitable for catastrophe risk and Bayesian heavy-tail loss modelling. Complements the frequentist [[evd]]/[[evir]]; related: [[mev]], [[tailloss]], [[extremes]], [[actuarial-pricing]].

## Similar tools
[[risk-profiler]]、[[riskportfolios]]、[[risky-router]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]
e.body_hk:
revdbayes 是貝葉斯極值模型分析工具（UCL 的 Paul Northrop，v1.5.7，2026-03 仍更新）：用 Ratio-of-Uniforms 方法對極值模型（GEV/GPD 等）做貝葉斯推斷，配套 rust 包支持。把 EVT 與貝葉斯結合——參數不確定性的完整後驗表達，適用於巨災風險、重尾損失的貝葉斯建模。與 [[evd]]/[[evir]]（頻率派）互補，關聯 [[mev]]、[[tailloss]]、[[extremes]]、[[actuarial-pricing]]。

## 同類工具
